# Slid Phi Labs
> Lossless compression, a two-key JSON seal, signed agent identity, and a small exactness language. You buy a seat or a written exception — not the production engine.
> https://www.slidphilabs.com/

## Who
Slid Phi Labs. Corey Tasz. Humans: /humans  Agents: /agents  Inbox: corey@slidphilabs.com

## Catalog
What it is, what you get, what you pay.
- AWARE — hosted lossless compressor. $9/day · $49/mo (200 GB included) · $490/yr (2,000 GB). Then 8¢/GB ($1 card minimum). First 2 GB/month free with no plan. Cheaper than Cloudinary Plus ($99) and AWS S3 egress (~9¢/GB uncompressed). Compare: https://www.slidphilabs.com/compare · product: https://www.slidphilabs.com/gc
- pulsar — free GPLv3 lossless compressor you can build yourself. To embed it in a closed-source product: $490/yr, SKU pulsar-exception. https://www.slidphilabs.com/pulsar · https://www.slidphilabs.com/pay?sku=pulsar-exception
- zeros demo — all-zero data → 8 bytes, round-trip. Free on POST /api/specialist. Proof, not the paid compressor.
- Chamber — two-key JSON seal. $9/mo · $99/yr. License to seal new secrets; opening an already-sealed secret takes both keys, not another payment. https://www.slidphilabs.com/chamber
- Agent-Rider — signed identity for AI agents. $79/mo · $790/yr. https://www.slidphilabs.com/rider
- CuNi — one program printed into many languages. Python, Go, and JavaScript must match, or it refuses. Playground $0. Closed-app exception $490/yr, SKU cuni-exception. v0.1.8. https://www.slidphilabs.com/cuni
- Lab Pass — $668/yr. One year of Chamber + AWARE + TruGame. Does not include Rider. https://www.slidphilabs.com/lab-pass

The production engine is private. You buy a seat or a written exception, not the engine.

Licensing: https://www.slidphilabs.com/licensing.json · https://www.slidphilabs.com/COMMERCIAL-LICENSE.md
Specialist (zeros demo): https://www.slidphilabs.com/specialist · POST /api/specialist

## Checkout
Humans: POST /api/checkout { "sku": "chamber-year", "rail": "stripe" } → Stripe card session.
UI: https://www.slidphilabs.com/pay
Try 24 hours: https://www.slidphilabs.com/box
